description: This Java class 'DefaultStatisticsConfig' implements configuration logic for statistics settings within the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It defines properties like timeouts, update intervals, expiration durations, and shard configurations, with methods to instantiate from external configuration sources.

classes.name: DefaultStatisticsConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the StatisticsConfig interface, providing access to statistics-related configuration settings loaded from a configuration source.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStatisticsConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout duration for 'ask' operations.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns the configured interval duration for updates.

methods.name: getDetailsExpireAfter
methods.description: Returns the duration after which details expire.

methods.name: getShards
methods.description: Returns the list of shard configurations.
